ambient_events: Water slaps the pilings under the boards and draws back.
A cleat sits empty at the jetty's edge, rope-scarred and waiting.
Out on the black water, something large and unlit holds its position.
The beam from the tower crosses the boards, and every rail on the jetty picks it up at once.
description: Where the hardstanding gives out and the boards begin. A concrete ramp takes the last two metres down to deck level, scored across so a wet boot has something to hold. A lifebelt in a steel cradle, one strut of it snapped. The pier runs NORTH from here and does not turn.
name: Jetty Head
